lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਤ ਨ ਕਤਹੁ ਬਾਤਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਪਰਤੀ ਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooran hot na katahu baatahi a(n)t paratee haar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: But it is not fulfilled at all, and in the end, it dies, exhausted. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸੂਖ ਨ ਸਹਜੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਇਹੈ ਇਸੁ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa(n)t sookh na sahaj upajai ihai is biuhaar ||
lines.translation: It does not produce tranquility, peace and poise; this is the way it works.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪ ਪਰ ਕਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਹਿ ਜਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: aap par kaa kachh na jaanai kaam krodhahi jaar ||1||
lines.translation: He does not know what belongs to him, and to others. He burns in sexual desire and anger. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਦਾਸ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਤਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)saar saagar dukh biaapio daas levahu taar ||
lines.translation: The world is enveloped by an ocean of pain; O Lord, please save Your slave!

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਰਣਾਇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮੪॥੧੦੭॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal saranaai naanak sad sadaa balihaar ||2||84||107||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Lotus Feet; Nanak is forever and ever a sacrifice. ||2||84||107||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੇ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੈ ਕਵਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੀਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: re paapee tai kavan kee mat leen ||
lines.translation: O sinner, who taught you to sin?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਘਰੀ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਦੀਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nimakh gharee na simar suaamee jeeu pi(n)d jin deen ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You do not contemplate your Lord and Master, even for an instant; it was He who gave you your body and soul. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਾਤ ਪੀਵਤ ਸਵੰਤ ਸੁਖੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਖੀਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: khaat peevat sava(n)t sukheeaa naam simarat kheen ||
lines.translation: Eating, drinking and sleeping, you are happy, but contemplating the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you are miserable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਰਭ ਉਦਰ ਬਿਲਲਾਟ ਕਰਤਾ ਤਹਾਂ ਹੋਵਤ ਦੀਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: garabh udar bilalaat karataa tahaa(n) hovat deen ||1||
lines.translation: In the womb of your mother, you cried and whined like a wretch. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਮਾਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਾਧਾ ਅਨਿਕ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੀਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa maad bikaar baadhaa anik jon bhrameen ||
lines.translation: And now, bound by great pride and corruption, you shall wander in endless incarnations.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਕਵਨ ਦੁਖ ਗਨੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਦ ਚੀਨੑ ॥੨॥੮੫॥੧੦੮॥
lines.transliteration: gobi(n)d bisare kavan dukh ganeeahi sukh naanak har pad cheenh ||2||85||108||
lines.translation: You have forgotten the Lord of the Universe; what misery will be your lot now? O Nanak, peace is found by realizing the sublime state of the Lord. ||2||85||108||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਚਰਨਹ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee ree charanah ot gahee ||
lines.translation: O mother, I have grasped the Protection, the Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪੇਖਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਤ ਬਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: darasan pekh meraa man mohio duramat jaat bahee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, my mind is fascinated, and evil-mindedness is taken away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਹ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਊਚ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਕਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: agah agaadh ooch abinaasee keemat jaat na kahee ||
lines.translation: He is Unfathomable, Incomprehensible, Exalted and High, Eternal and Imperishable; His worth cannot be appraised.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਬਿਗਸਿਓ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਮਹੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal pekh pekh man bigasio poor rahio srab mahee ||1||
lines.translation: Gazing upon Him, gazing upon Him in the water and on the land, my mind has blossomed forth in ecstasy. He is totally pervading and permeating all. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧਹ ਕੀਨੋ ਸਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: deen daiaal preetam manamohan mil saadhah keeno sahee ||
lines.translation: Merciful to the meek, my Beloved, Enticer of my mind; meeting with the Holy, He is known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਜੀਵਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਭੀਰ ਨ ਫਹੀ ॥੨॥੮੬॥੧੦੯॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar jeevat har naanak jam kee bheer na phahee ||2||86||109||
lines.translation: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on the Lord, Nanak lives; the Messenger of Death cannot catch or torment him. ||2||86||109||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee ree man mero matavaaro ||
lines.translation: O mother, my mind is intoxicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੇਖਿ ਦਇਆਲ ਅਨਦ ਸੁਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਪਿਓ ਖੁਮਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pekh daiaal anad sukh pooran har ras rapio khumaaro ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Gazing upon the Merciful Lord, I am filled with bliss and peace; imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, I am intoxicated. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਭਏ ਊਜਲ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਤ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਤ ਕਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: niramal bhae oojal jas gaavat bahur na hovat kaaro ||
lines.translation: I have become spotless and pure, singing the Sacred Praises of the Lord; I shall never again be dirtied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਡੋਰੀ ਰਾਚੀ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: charan kamal siu doree raachee bhetio purakh apaaro ||1||
lines.translation: My awareness is focused on the Lotus Feet of God; I have met the Infinite, Supreme Being. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਦੀਨੇ ਦੀਪਕ ਭਇਓ ਉਜਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar gahi leene sarabas deene deepak bhaio ujaaro ||
lines.translation: Taking me by the hand, He has given me everything; He has lit up my lamp.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਸਿਕ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਮੂਹਾਂ ਤਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੮੭॥੧੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rasik bairaagee kulah samoohaa(n) taaro ||2||87||110||
lines.translation: O Nanak, savoring the Naam, the Name of the Lord, I have become detached; my generations have been carried across as well. ||2||87||110||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਈ ਰੀ ਆਨ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaee ree aan simar mar jaa(n)hi ||
lines.translation: O mother, by meditating in remembrance on some other, the mortal dies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਆਗਿ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਪਟਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tiaag gobid jeean ko daataa maaiaa sa(n)g lapataahi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Forsaking the Lord of the Universe, the Giver of souls, the mortal is engrossed and entangled in Maya. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਅਨ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam bisaar chalahi an maarag narak ghor mahi paahi ||
lines.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he walks on some other path, and falls into the most horrible hell.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਸਜਾਂਈ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਗਰਭੈ ਗਰਭਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: anik sajaa(n)ee ganat na aavai garabhai garabh bhramaahi ||1||
lines.translation: He suffers uncounted punishments, and wanders from womb to womb in reincarnation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤੇ ਸੇ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: se dhanava(n)te se pativa(n)te har kee saran samaahi ||
lines.translation: They alone are wealthy, and they alone are honorable, who are absorbed in the Sanctuary of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਗੁ ਜੀਤਿਓ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ॥੨॥੮੮॥੧੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur prasaad naanak jag jeetio bahur na aavahi jaa(n)hi ||2||88||111||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, O Nanak, they conquer the world; they do not come and go in reincarnation ever again. ||2||88||111||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਰਗ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: saarag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Saarang, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾਟੀ ਕੁਟਿਲਤਾ ਕੁਠਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaatee kutilataa kuthaar ||
lines.translation: The Lord has cut down the crooked tree of my deceit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬਨ ਦਹਨ ਭਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਪਰਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhram ban dahan bhae khin bheetar raam naam parahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The forest of doubt is burnt away in an instant, by the fire of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਪਰਹਰੀਆ ਕਾਢੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh ni(n)daa parahareeaa kaadhe saadhoo kai sa(n)g maar ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger and slander are gone; in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have beaten them and driven them out.
